scope: USA source-class/feline/modality sweep followed by worldwide multilingual/source-class sweep

records.title: Olaparib + meloxicam for feline mammary carcinoma
records.center: University of Minnesota Veterinary Medical Center
records.contacts: University of Minnesota Clinical Investigation Center / study contact listed on official page
records.notes: Pilot PARP-inhibitor plus NSAID treatment study for cats with measurable confirmed mammary carcinoma.

records.title: TriKE immunotherapy + hypofractionated radiation for canine sarcoma
records.center: University of Minnesota Veterinary Medical Center
records.contacts: University of Minnesota Clinical Investigation Center / study contact listed on official page
records.notes: Novel TriKE immunotherapy combined with hypofractionated radiation; confirmed sarcoma at least 2 cm and minimum weight 7 kg among criteria.

records.title: Investigational cancer vaccine with standard-of-care therapy
records.status: Currently enrolling at selected MedVet hospitals
records.contacts: MedVet clinical studies team / participating MedVet hospitals listed on official page
records.notes: Vaccine is provided at no charge; dogs must receive appropriate standard-of-care therapy and have histologically confirmed eligible cancer. Site-specific enrollment restrictions apply.

records.title: Enzistat immunotherapy for inoperable or incurable canine solid tumors
records.center: University of Queensland School of Veterinary Science
records.contacts: UQ VETS Small Animal Hospital — uqvets.sa@uq.edu.au
records.notes: Two formal treatment cohorts: palliative advanced/terminal solid tumors and tumor-shrinkage prior to possible surgery. Six-week oral Enzistat course; trial drug and research assessments covered.

records.title: Experimental vaccine for canine appendicular osteosarcoma
records.center: University of Queensland School of Veterinary Science
records.status: Listed on UQ current clinical trials page as seeking dogs
records.contacts: University of Queensland School of Veterinary Science / UQ VETS
records.notes: Two vaccine formulations; newly diagnosed appendicular osteosarcoma, no evidence of metastasis, proceeding to surgery.

records.title: Organoid-guided molecular targeted therapy for canine and feline solid tumors
records.center: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center
records.contacts: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center — 03-5841-5420
records.notes: Personalized treatment trial: organoid screening identifies a candidate molecular targeted drug, then the patient receives that drug. Requires measurable solid tumor and ability to attend Tokyo follow-up visits; study drug cost waived.

records.title: Lapatinib for feline transitional cell carcinoma
records.center: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center
records.contacts: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center — 03-5841-5420
records.notes: Investigator-initiated HER2-targeted lapatinib treatment trial for cats with bladder/urethral transitional cell carcinoma; prior anticancer drug, radiation, or surgical excision excluded; NSAIDs allowed.

records.title: IDO1 inhibitor for canine bladder cancer
records.center: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center
records.contacts: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center — 03-5841-5420
records.notes: Oral IDO1 inhibitor treatment trial; follow-up at weeks 1, 3 and 5; study drug cost waived.

records.title: Polymer-conjugated anticancer drug for refractory canine solid tumors
records.center: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center
records.contacts: University of Tokyo Veterinary Medical Center — 03-5841-5420
records.notes: IV polymer-conjugated pirarubicin-based investigational anticancer therapy every two weeks for unresectable/metastatic malignant solid tumors lacking effective alternatives; study drug cost waived.

records.title: Anti-PD-L1 antibody immunotherapy for canine malignant tumors
records.contacts: Hokkaido University clinical research team — huvcr@vetmed.hokudai.ac.jp
records.notes: Experimental canine anti-PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitor; explicitly recruiting dogs with malignant tumors including oral malignant melanoma with lung metastasis.

records.title: Adjuvant carboplatin chemotherapy for canine splenic hemangiosarcoma
records.center: Ontario Veterinary College — University of Guelph
records.notes: Four carboplatin treatments covered by study; confirmed splenic HSA after splenectomy, no metastasis and no previous chemotherapy among listed criteria.
